definitions.explanation: A visual representation such as a chart, map, or drawing.

examples.japanese: {図|ず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{図|ず}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{分|わ}かりやすい→分かりやすい：09582_wakariyasui⟧。
examples.english: This diagram is easy to understand.

examples.japanese: ⟦{説明|せつめい}→説明：01449_setsumei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{図|ず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。

notes:
{図|ず} refers to diagrams, illustrations, and visual representations.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{図表|ずひょう}→図表：04317_zuhyou⟧ (chart, diagram)
- ⟦{図形|ずけい}→図形：04036_zukei⟧ (figure, shape - geometric)
- ⟦{図解|ずかい}→図解：18235_zukai⟧ (illustration, graphic explanation)
- ⟦{図書|としょ}→図書：03459_tosho⟧ (books) - note: reading changes to と
- ⟦{図書館|としょかん}→図書館：00580_toshokan⟧ (library)
- ⟦{地図|ちず}→地図：02914_chizu⟧ (map)
- ⟦{設計図|せっけいず}→設計図：14805_sekkeizu⟧ (blueprint, design plan)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {図|ず}: diagram, figure (schematic representation)
- ⟦{絵|え}→絵：02613_e⟧: picture, drawing (artistic)
- ⟦グラフ→グラフ：04864_gurafu⟧: graph (borrowed from English)
- ⟦{表|ひょう}→表：19354_hyou⟧: table, chart (with rows and columns)
